## Public-data safety checklist

- [ ] Tests and examples use synthetic fixtures only.
- [ ] No PMGS source package, generated SQLite database, public export tree, registration material, credential, or local absolute path is included.
- [ ] Official source text remains separate from derived metadata or interpretation.
- [ ] Public artifacts still exclude source archives and canonical database downloads.
